content:
maria: quick heads-up — partner SI asked for a twilight window this week to coordinate a driver rollback handshake. they want minimal blast radius and a clear telemetry cutover plan
ken: ok — which build are they targeting?
devon: seems like their infra is on driver 535.x with cuda 12.2 custom stack, right?
maria: yes, 535.86 + custom cuda12.2 patches. they hit perf regressions after the distro kernel bump. they want a pin + smoke rollback that can be reversed within 30m if things go south
ashley: we can schedule a twilight slot (02:00-03:00 PT). night-ops team available. suggested steps: 1) pin driver bundle on marketplace image, 2) canary in two host pools, 3) run perf smoke and kvcache regression tests, 4) signal back to partner
suresh: recommend adding an explicit kernel ABI check before the pin. we saw mismatches earlier — causes cryptic hangs.
ken: agree. also need comms wording for the customer-facing partner channel: keep it "non-alarming" and include rollback ETA + contact. I'll draft.
maria: draft suggestion: "We're coordinating a low-risk driver pin+rollback test with our SI partner during a night window. Expect brief traffic steering; we'll revert automatically on regressions." thoughts?
devon: fine. add: "If perf drops >10% or error-rate >0.5%, auto-rollback triggers."
ashley: test matrix — I'll run: 
```
# smoke commands
./run_smoke.sh --suite=kvcache,latency --workers=8
# perf baseline collector
curl -sS http://telemetry/api/baseline?run=nightly > /tmp/baseline.json
```
oncall-bot: reminder — create incident channel for the window: #ops-driver-night-4370001234
deploy-bot: deployment job queued: marketplace-image-pin-535.86 -> canary-pools [job id: 2026-NIGHT-77]
suresh: partner ask: can we expose a read-only telemetry slice so they can correlate their traces? small S3 prefix with sanitized traces would work.
ken: security ok with sanitized slice. maria, please coordinate with partner to get list of trace ids they need.
maria: will do. also need approval from infra for fast rollback policy (scripted). devon, can you add a fallback that will route traffic to model-variant-lite if driver fails?
devon: yes, can add a routing policy: if node-level health < 90% or token-latency > 150ms, route to variant-lite. I'll bundle as a simple YAML override: 
```
fallback:
  condition:
    - node_health < 0.9
    - tail_latency_ms > 150
  action: route: model-variant-lite
  rollback: auto
```
maria: perfect. timeline: planning notes by EOD, partner signoff by 18:00 PT, twilight window 02:00-03:00 PT, post-mortem snapshot by 06:00 PT
ashley: ops checklist: image pin, canary deploy, perf smoke, kvcache smoke, telemetry export, rollback script test. I'll post checklist to the channel before EOD.
suresh: partner will have a rep on call. they'll join ~01:45 PT for final sync.
ken: i'll prepare the external comms and internal incident channel template.
maria: thanks all. small request — tag me when the marketplace-image-pin job starts. i'll be on standby. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: job started: marketplace-image-pin-535.86 -> canary-pools [job id: 2026-NIGHT-77]
ken: thanks. if anything unexpected, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping me directly.
maria: noted. closing the loop once partner confirms.
